"""Account original V162 scientific owners and the independent mask auditor."""
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V162-flat-target-anchor-v1')
training=read(root/'status-v1.json');post=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert training['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review'
assert post['status']=='completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
assert set(training['completed'])=={'parity','smoke','train'}
assert set(post['completed'])=={'checkpoint-validation','review','scores','metric-audit','render'}
assert all(v['returncode']==0 for v in post['completed'].values())
owners=[('training-controller',training['owner'])]+[(n,read(root/f'{n}-result-v1.json')['owner']) for n in ['parity','smoke','train']]
owners += [('postprocess-controller',post['owner'])]+[(n,v['owner']) for n,v in post['completed'].items()]
assert len(owners)==10
mask=read(root/'training-mask-audit-v1.json');assert mask['mask_arrays_checked']==1000
owners += [('independent-mask-auditor',mask['owner'])]
assert len(owners)==len({(o['pid'],o['created']) for _,o in owners})==11
records=[]
for stage,owner in owners:
 assert not live(owner),(stage,owner)
 try:
  p=psutil.Process(owner['pid']);terminal='PID-reused-original-terminal' if abs(p.create_time()-owner['created'])>=.01 else p.status()
 except psutil.NoSuchProcess:terminal='absent'
 records.append({'stage':stage,'owner':owner,'terminal_state':terminal})
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');assert review['component_forwards']==3288 and review['new_prediction_arrays']==review['control_replayed_exact']==1644
paths=set();newpaths=set();controls=0
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
 c=read(binding['path']);assert c['component_forwards']==822
 forward=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(c['forward_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
 observations=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(c['observation_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
 assert [r['returned_forwards'] for r in forward]==list(range(1,823)) and observations==c['observations']
 control=c['arm']=='harmonic-control';assert c['adopted_array_storage_after_actual_replay']==control
 for row in observations:
  p=Path(row['prediction']['path']);assert p.is_relative_to('/mnt/external') and str(p) not in paths
  paths.add(str(p));assert row['archive_replayed_bit_exact']==control
  if control:controls+=1
  else:newpaths.add(str(p))
assert len(paths)==3288 and len(newpaths)==controls==1644
parity=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json');assert len(parity['CUDA_anchor_loss_checks'])==10
head_calls=parity['component_forward_evaluations']+sum(read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json')['counts'].values())+sum(read(root/'train-result-v1.json')['counts'].values())+review['component_forwards']
assert head_calls==5364
excluded={os.getpid()}|{p.pid for p in psutil.Process().parents()};matching=[]
for p in psutil.process_iter(['pid','cmdline','status']):
 if p.pid in excluded or p.info['status'] in ['zombie','dead']:continue
 if any(t==str(root) or t.startswith(str(root)+'/') for t in p.info['cmdline'] or []):matching.append(p.info)
assert not matching,matching
output=root/'execution-completion-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'all10-scientific-owners-and-independent-mask-auditor-terminal','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'recorded_owner_count':11,'scientific_owner_count':10,'owners':records,'live_matching_root_argv':matching,
    'head_calls':head_calls,'head_image_evaluations':11424,'additional_leaf_output_CUDA_backwards':10,
    'actual_parent_root_calls':0,'actual_DINO_backbone_calls':0,'new_source_constructions':0,'new_sensor_sampler_calls':0,
    'cache_batches_reused':1000,'unique_training_observations_reused':4000,'scientific_stage_failures':0,'full_training_restarts':0,
    'review_root_calls':3288,'control_prediction_replays_exact':1644,'new_prediction_arrays':1644,
    'new_array_bytes':sum(Path(p).stat().st_size for p in newpaths),
    'training_completion':ref(root/'status-v1.json'),'postprocess_completion':ref(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json'),
    'independent_training_mask_audit':ref(root/'training-mask-audit-v1.json'),
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'All10 original scientific controllers/workers plus one independent array-only mask auditor terminal.5364 root head calls exclude separate CPU tests and10 prefix leaf-output loss backwards. All1000 control trace/raw/EMA/Adam and1644 actual output replays reproduce V161 harmonic. Only anchor weight0/.25 changes;no new inference inputs,NN sources,parent/DINO/source/noise/RAW/original calls. All1644 new arrays external. Auxiliary readiness-verifier stale-path failure and corrected revision2 are separately preserved;no scientific retry.'})
print('PASS10 scientific owners plus mask auditor terminal;5364 head calls/11424 images;1644 new external arrays')
